description: Simple 2-stage curriculum: NAP=4 (bs=8, 8000 steps) → NAP=8 (bs=16, 4000 steps). Equal compute per stage (64K bs-units each, 128K total = exp365). Independent per-stage cosine LR with 10%% warmup. Anchor tree top-down from final NAP=8. Adam state carry via averaged additive merge. Target arch matches exp398 (snap-to-NAP=8 everywhere = 87M).
